name: rumbo
description: Keep agreed work connected to its artifacts, evidence and human decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep work on its agreed course
interface.longDescription: Inspect the agreed goal and constraints, claim bounded tasks, register exact artifact revisions, run deterministic acceptance checks and request human decisions. The project board separates work claims, narrow check receipts, reviewer assertions and human acceptance. Rumbo does not grant authority, run arbitrary commands, or prove that every requirement is correct.
defaultPrompt: What evidence is missing before acceptance?
Which work became stale after the last change?

publication.release_notes: 0.3.3 local review candidate: bundles shared engine 0.3.2, whose refusals name the current revision or next step, which no longer creates an empty ledger for agent commands or a lost project, and whose owner registry gains list and remove. Owner-provisioned aliases and worker-only authority are unchanged. Actual host installation and reviewer connection remain separate verification gates.
